verdict.rationale: Corporations Canada names a sanctioned third-party channel: a separate fee and processing track for registered intermediaries ($200, 1 day). Its online filing also documents delegated roles, "full access manager" and "filing collaborator", with shared access and permissions managed alongside the corporation key. These are first-party mentions of a provider acting for a company, but each appears only in passing. Missing for 10: documentation of how a provider becomes a registered intermediary and what it may file, details on the scope of permissions for filing collaborators and managers, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the intermediary rail works.
